save.intro: A little closer to what matters.
featureNotes: Give each goal a target and a place in your plan.
Follow your deposits and see how far you have come.
Keep your personal goals at the centre of the experience.

01-goals.png: Set targets for the things you care about and see each goal's balance and progress together.
02-monthly-plan.png: See what to save this month and which goals need your attention.
03-what-if-planner.png: Try a different monthly saving amount and explore how it changes your finish date.
04-progress-charts.png: See your saving history in cumulative and monthly charts.
05-monthly-top-up.png: Set a top-up amount and a day to help make saving a regular habit.
06-saving-challenges.png: Find a rhythm with challenges, from weekly saving to a no-spend month.
07-activity-history.png: Review, filter and edit saving entries across your goals.
08-dark-theme.png: Switch to a dark appearance while keeping your goals and progress in view.

featureNotes: Choose a duration and put distracting apps on pause.
Make space for family time without an internet connection.
Get started without creating an account or seeing ads.
functions: Choose how long you want to put distractions aside and be present.
Phone, Messages and Camera remain available during your session.
Use Bond Time without internet, accounts or ads.

featureNotes: Add a pause before opening tempting food-ordering apps.
Give each impulse time to become a considered choice.
Keep your habit tracking and reflections on your device.

01-pause-800x1400.png: Protect selected apps and give an impulse a moment to pass.
02-unlock-800x1400.png: Answer a quiz, wait through a cooldown or use a key for a short unlock.
03-home-food-800x1400.png: Find ideas for a craving and keep a list of the food already in your fridge.
04-streak-800x1400.png: Log days without impulse orders and follow your next milestone.
05-savings-800x1400.png: Record what you chose not to spend, with custom amounts and notes.
06-orders-avoided-800x1400.png: Log the impulse orders you resist and follow your progress over time.
07-craving-note-800x1400.png: Choose a trigger or write a short reflection before continuing to the quiz.
08-difficulty-800x1400.png: Set the quiz difficulty to match the amount of friction you want.

featureNotes: Move between everyday maths, scientific functions and tax calculations.
Choose colours and appearance settings that feel like you.
Calculate without an internet connection or advertising.

01-basic-calculator.png: Use a familiar calculator with clear keys and a subtle glow.
02-scientific-mode.png: Work with trigonometry, powers, roots and logarithms from one keypad.
03-tax-calculator.png: Add or remove tax and see the split, including India's CGST and SGST.
04-make-it-yours.png: Choose a glow colour, try a gradient or let the colour change at random.
05-two-key-shapes.png: Switch between round keys and crisp, cut-corner squares.
06-appearance.png: Pick an appearance or let GlowCalc follow your device's theme.
07-calculation-history.png: Revisit past calculations and tap a result to use it again.
08-meet-your-mood-face.png: A small character reacts as you calculate, adding a little joy to everyday maths.

featureNotes: Set alarms, run timers and use a stopwatch in one app.
Choose a clock style, colours and sounds to suit your day.
Use your time tools offline, without accounts or analytics.
clock.upgradeNote: Math lock, analog and digital faces are included. Additional alarm locks, clock faces, colours and sounds are available with Premium; see the app's listing for current options.

01.png: Create alarms for any days of the week and use them offline.
02.png: A full-screen alarm appears over the lock screen with snooze and stop controls.
03.png: Use the math lock to solve a challenge before dismissing an alarm.
04.png: Explore math, pattern, gesture and typing locks. Additional lock methods require Premium.
05.png: A face that feels like you
Choose analog or digital faces, or explore additional styles with Premium.
06.png: Bring a clock face to your home screen with a widget. More face styles are available with Premium.
07.png: Run multiple timers, use quick presets and see which timer is done in its notification.
08.png: Premium brings additional clock faces, tunes, unlock methods and appearance options.
